section.catchline: Restrictions on mail order or Internet sales.
section.subsection:
For purposes of this section:
"Distributor" means a person, wherever residing or located, who: is licensed in this state to purchase a non-taxed nicotine product or a non-taxed electronic cigarette product; and stores, sells, or otherwise disposes of a nicotine product or an electronic cigarette product. "Licensed person" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-14-409. "Order or purchase" includes: by mail or delivery service; through the Internet or computer network; by telephone; or through some other electronic method. "Retailer" means any person who sells a nicotine product or an electronic cigarette product to consumers for personal consumption.

A person, distributor, manufacturer, or retailer shall not:
cause a nicotine product or an electronic cigarette product to be ordered or purchased by anyone other than a licensed person; or knowingly provide substantial assistance to a person who violates this section.

subsection.subsection: Each order or purchase of a nicotine product or an electronic cigarette product in violation of Subsection (2) constitutes a separate violation under this section.

section.subsection: If a person knowingly violates this section, the court shall order any profits, gain, gross receipts, or other benefit from the violation to be disgorged and paid to the state treasurer for deposit in the General Fund.
